summary: Frontend-only testing for the new /services/:slug detail pages. All 6 service detail routes render correctly with title, tagline, intro, 'Who this is for', 5 signs, and 4 approach items. Navigation from home service cards (service-learn-0..5), back-link, book CTA (routes to /#contact), next-service (with wrap-around from online-consultation -> anxiety-depression), and language toggle (EN <-> HI, translating title/signs/approach) all work. Invalid slug (/services/does-not-exist) correctly redirects to /. Header remains visible on inner routes. Home page regression: all main sections (services, contact, about, selfcheck) load; self-check testids (selfcheck-section, selfcheck-start-btn) present. Backend was NOT retested per instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: ServiceDetail.jsx: the invalid-slug redirect uses useEffect + navigate('/', {replace:true}) with an early `if (!svc) return null`. This works but briefly renders null; consider a <Navigate replace to='/'/> for cleaner intent.
serviceDetails.js is a large (~285 line) bilingual data file, acceptable but could be split into en/hi files if it grows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Service detail routes fully validated. Book button sets hash to #contact and the LandingPage hash-scroll effect triggers scrollIntoView (Lenis smooth scroll takes ~1s to reach contact section, so a longer wait may be needed if verifying viewport position). All 6 slugs and their bilingual content verified.
